observation_indicators.observable_fil: May concern, pinagmulan, hindi pa tiyak at hinihinging aksyon ang ulat; pinipili ang tamang tatanggap at channel; tinutukoy kung paano kukumpirmahin ang follow-up.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes concern, source, uncertainty and requested action; selects the right recipient and channel; specifies how follow-up will be confirmed.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ibinabahagi sa pampublikong grupo ang personal na form o walang malinaw na hinihinging aksyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Shares a personal form publicly or omits a clear requested action.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May concern, pinagmulan, hindi pa tiyak at hinihinging aksyon ang ulat; pinipili ang tamang tatanggap at channel; tinutukoy kung paano kukumpirmahin ang follow-up. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Includes concern, source, uncertainty and requested action; selects the right recipient and channel; specifies how follow-up will be confirmed. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tumpak ang ulat ngunit walang follow-up owner; ipatukoy kung sino ang sasagot at paano malalaman kung natanggap.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Gives an accurate report but no follow-up owner; ask who should respond and how receipt will be confirmed.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ibinabahagi sa pampublikong grupo ang personal na form o walang malinaw na hinihinging aksyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Shares a personal form publicly or omits a clear requested action.
